_note: Roles are the fixed contract; agents and models are swappable per role. The control UI's Team tab writes default_agent/default_model here. A task may override either at creation, after which the choice is frozen in state/tasks/<id>/state.json.

backend-dev.description: Implements NestJS/Prisma work in apps/api and shared contract in packages/types.

frontend-dev.description: Implements Next.js work in apps/web, mobile-first.

fullstack-architect.description: Designs the change across api + web + packages/types before anyone codes it: the shared contract, the data model, and which files each dev touches. Commits the contract, not the implementation.

tester-e2e.description: Independent tester. Runs the real app in a browser with Playwright against vps_dev (via .nexa-agent/scripts/e2e-dev.sh on :3100/:3101, never production's :3000/:3001), plus typecheck/lint/jest. Never edits application source.

bug-fixer.description: Fixes defects listed in the tester's failure report.

reviewer.description: Reviews the cumulative diff for correctness, security and regressions.
